svg.aria-label: Start C4 + E4, end D4 + E4. The lower voice moves from C4 to D4. The upper voice holds E4. Oblique motion: one voice holds while the other moves.
svg.title: Change 3: only the lower voice rises

g.text: How to read this graphic: The dashed circle on C4 is the start; the arrow takes the
lower voice right to D4, one key below the held E4. Compare with change 2: same voice
